author: Podily
description:

From legendary museum robberies and priceless paintings that vanished without a trace to elaborate forgery scandals, international smuggling networks, and billion-dollar art frauds, each episode uncovers the extraordinary true stories behind history's most notorious art crimes.

Discover the secrets of infamous art thieves, master forgers, corrupt dealers, organized crime syndicates, and the investigators determined to recover the world's missing cultural treasures. Explore the thefts of works by Leonardo da Vinci, Rembrandt, Picasso, Van Gogh, and other legendary artists, alongside ancient antiquities trafficking, Nazi-looted art, archaeological plunder, counterfeit masterpieces, and the dark history of the international art trade.

Blending art history, true crime, mystery, and criminal investigation, The Art Crimes Podcast reveals how greed, deception, ambition, and obsession have shaped the history of art. Whether you're fascinated by unsolved mysteries, famous paintings, museum heists, or the hidden criminal networks behind stolen art, discover the remarkable stories of masterpieces worth stealing—and the people willing to risk everything to possess them.

author: Fifty Mill Media
description:
Welcome to Off the Cuff with Mel

I'm Mel, a former prison officer with a very different perspective on what really happens behind bars.

When I first started working in prisons, I thought the people I was locking up represented the worst of society. What I experienced challenged that assumption completely.

Off the Cuff is about the real people and stories behind crime, prison and the justice system.

I sit down with former prisoners, prison officers, victims, families, campaigners and others whose lives have been shaped by the system to have honest conversations about what happened, what prison is really like, what needs to change and what happens when people are given a second chance.

These aren't conversations about excusing crime or pretending that actions don't have consequences. They're about understanding the people, circumstances and experiences behind the headlines.

Expect long-form interviews, first-hand prison stories and perspectives from both sides of the prison door.

Subscribe and join the conversation.

title: The Relaxed Business Owner with Michael Clark
author: Michael Clark Business Advisory
description:
You didn’t start a business just to buy yourself a stressful, 60-hour-a-week job. If your company demands every waking minute of your time while leaving you with thin margins and zero freedom, something is broken.


Welcome to The Relaxed Business Owner with Michael Clark, presented by Michael Clark Business Advisory. 


Hosted by straight-talking business strategist Michael Clark, this podcast is built around one simple rule: your business exists to serve your life, not consume it. 


In each episode, Michael sits down with proven operators, specialists, and coaches to strip away the fluff and hand you practical, commercial strategies you can implement right away. 


Tune in to learn how to:

  • Reclaim Your Time: Build repeatable systems, delegate low-value tasks, and structure your calendar so your business runs smoothly—even when you take a holiday.
  • Scale Without Wasting Money: Master data-driven advertising (Google and Meta Ads) alongside zero-dollar organic growth strategies that turn happy clients into five-star referrals.
  • Keep Your Best People: Prevent team burnout, stay ahead of workplace psychosocial safety obligations, and build a culture where top performers want to stay.
  • Win Higher-Value Clients: Ditch desperate networking and scarcity mindsets by niching down, collaborating with strategic B2B partners, and crafting irresistible offers.
  • Lead Like a True CEO: Overcome imposter syndrome, stop treating profit like a dirty word, and make clear, data-backed decisions that protect both your bank account and your personal life.


Whether you’re a solo operator looking to break through your first revenue ceiling or an established director ready to step back from the frontline,

The Relaxed Business Owner with Michael Clark gives you the playbook to earn more, work less, and actually enjoy the business you built. 


Hit follow now and start building a business that loves you back.

When a peculiar job opportunity arises for red-headed men, Jabez Wilson finds himself drawn into a web of deception that only Sherlock Holmes can unravel. The Red-Headed League offers Wilson a curious salary for a seemingly pointless task—copying the Encyclopedia Britannica. But when the league abruptly disbands, Wilson’s discovery leads him to Holmes's doorstep, demanding answers. What sinister plot lies beneath this bizarre organization?

As Holmes and his faithful companion, Dr. Watson, delve deeper, they uncover a brilliantly orchestrated scheme that unravels clues tied to a notorious criminal. With a clever twist on the idea of identity, this classic tale explores themes of trust, cunning, and the lengths to which individuals will go for their ambitions. Listeners will be captivated by Holmes's sharp deductions and wit as they follow the investigation filled with unexpected turns.

Join Holmes and Watson on this thrilling journey as they navigate a labyrinth of clues, all while exposing the true nature of the Red-Headed League. Will they solve the mystery before it’s too late? Dive into this beloved Sherlock Holmes adventure and experience the excitement of detective work like never before. Perfect for fans of classic detective fiction and new listeners alike!

title: K12 BOSS
author: Matt Callison and Kartik Mangalam
description:
K12 BOSS (Biggest Opportunity for Student Success) is a podcast for K–12 educators built around a question schools were never designed to answer: If AI writes the code, what are we teaching?

For the first time, students don't have to wait until they've mastered programming to turn their ideas into real, working software. AI has removed the technical barriers, opening extraordinary opportunities for creativity, problem-solving, entrepreneurship, and student success. The ceiling is gone.

Hosts Dr. Kartik Mangalam, AI researcher and founder of SigIQ.ai, and Dr. Matt Callison, Director of Innovation at South Fayette Township School District, explore what this shift means for teaching, learning, and the future of education.

Each episode features real conversations with teachers, principals, and district leaders who aren't waiting for permission or a perfect roadmap. They're already moving. You'll hear what they're building, what's getting in their way, how they're overcoming obstacles, and what they're learning along the way.

And we don't stop at conversation. Every episode includes a practical, hands-on workshop with a project you can try with a student or an entire class that week.

No AI hype. No endless news roundups. No waiting for the future of education to arrive.

Real educators. Real students. Real software. And practical ideas you can put to work Monday morning.

K12 BOSS. The ceiling is gone.

title: Pixels to Press
author: Keira Dooley
description:
Pixels to Press is the podcast where creativity meets strategy — where fine art, graphic design, digital marketing, and traditional printmaking all pull up a chair at the same table.
I’m Keira Dooley: fine artist, and principal designer and founder of Dooley Design Group. For more than a decade I’ve worked at the intersection of the handmade and the digital — pulling prints on an etching press one day, building accessible, human-centered websites and marketing strategy the next. This show is where those worlds come together, and where I share what I’ve learned with people who make things for a living and colleagues who champion authentic, universal design for marketing in the print and digital realms.
AI is not the end of craft. It's the newest tool on a very old bench. The makers who thrive will be the ones who keep their core skills sharp, their point of view clear, and the compassionate human touch at the center of the work.
Each episode, we dig into the real experience of making meaningful creative work today. Expect honest conversations about human-centered and accessible design, practical marketing roadmaps you can actually use, and approachable artistic techniques — from brand strategy to SEO / AEO, to woodcut prints and watercolor. We'll dip into strategy, pure craft, and the art of growing creatively and technically without losing the joy that made you want to create in the first place.
Because that’s really what this is: a community for the human-centered maker. Whether you’re an entrepreneur, an educator, a marketer, a designer, a fine artist, or some wonderful combination in between, you’ll find something here to sharpen your skills, spark your imagination, and remind you that you’re not navigating this shift alone.
New episodes bring new stories, new techniques, and new reasons to keep making. Evolve your craft. Find your people. Design with joy.
Welcome to Pixels to Press.

It’s a fight to believe the promises of God. It’s a fight to believe the gospel—that Jesus died in our place, for our sins, and rose from the dead to give us eternal life!

That’s why Paul wrote, “Fight the good fight of the faith” (1 Timothy 6:12).

And near the end of his life, Paul declared, “I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith” (2 Timothy 4:7).

Following Jesus isn’t easy. Trusting God isn’t always easy. Resisting temptation isn’t easy. Loving God and loving others isn’t easy.

It’s a fight. And it’s a fight worth fighting!

That’s why The Fight Pod exists. Through honest conversations, biblical truth, and practical encouragement, our mission is to strengthen your faith, stir your love for Jesus, and inspire you to stay in the fight!

Stay in the Fight. Keep the Faith. Finish the Race.

title: The Sea Mystery (Inspector French Uncovers the Truth)
author: Freeman Wills Crofts
description:
When a sunken crate surfaces during a routine fishing trip, Inspector French stumbles upon a chilling mystery that shatters the calm of coastal life. Inside lies an unidentified body, setting off a chain of events that will test the limits of his analytical prowess. Who was this victim, and what sinister secrets lie beneath the waves?

In 'The Sea Mystery,' listeners dive deep into a thrilling investigation filled with unexpected twists and a cast of intriguing characters. As Inspector French meticulously pieces together clues, he faces not only the chilling reality of a clever crime but also the challenge of navigating the complex relationships within a tight-knit community that may hold the key to the truth.

Bridettes is the first and only podcast dedicated to child and forced marriage survivor stories from across religions, cultures, and communities. Hosted by Dr. Tamara MC, a child marriage survivor who was married at twelve in a cult in Texas.

Dr. MC speaks with survivors, therapists, legal experts, legislators, and advocates about child and forced marriage, coercive control, trafficking, and the lives survivors build on their own terms.

Long-form conversations make room for childhood memories, family relationships, the circumstances of marriage, the struggle to leave, and the complicated years that follow. We also make room for laughter, love, ambition, and joy.

Child marriage was legal in all fifty U.S. states until Delaware became the first to ban it without exceptions in 2018. Child marriage remains legal in the majority of states. Approximately 315,000 minors were married in the United States between 2000 and 2021, 86% of them girls. Worldwide, an estimated 640 million women and girls were married before eighteen, and 12 million more girls marry each year.

Our position is clear: end child marriage. Eighteen, no exceptions. Not for parents, judges, religion, or culture.

The name Bridettes reclaims “little brides.” We borrow the glamour, glitter, sequins, and sky-high kicks of the Radio City Rockettes and turn the chorus line into a celebration of survivor power.

Arm in arm, we're a kickline of survivors breaking down walls, kicking open doors, and smashing through the silence. There's room for every body, every voice, every choice.

Kick free. Kick back. Kick together.

Our conversations explore child marriage, forced marriage, sexual abuse, domestic and intimate partner violence, coercive control, human and familial trafficking, polygamy, female genital mutilation (FGM), domestic servitude, cults, spiritual and religious trauma, and the consequences of abuse, including complex PTSD.

We also examine isolation through homeschooling, the misuse of religious authority, and the legal barriers that can keep married children from accessing protection or leaving abusive relationships.

Guests include survivors from Christian, Muslim, Jewish, Hindu, Mormon, and secular backgrounds, alongside therapists, legal experts, lawmakers, and advocates working to end child marriage.

The show engages with the work of organizations including Unchained At Last, the National Coalition to End Child Marriage, Equality Now, and the AHA Foundation. We explore the laws that permit minors to marry, the exceptions that remain, and the efforts to close them.

You don't have to be a child marriage survivor to belong here. If you've experienced control through fear, money, family, or religion, or struggled to name what happened to you, there's room for you in the line.

Dr. Tamara MC is a child marriage survivor, social scientist, journalist, and activist whose work has appeared in more than 100 publications. She serves on the steering committee of the National Coalition to End Child Marriage and has contributed to legislative efforts to ban child marriage across the United States. She is writing her memoir, CHILD BRIDE.

Bridettes aims to create the world's largest oral-history archive of child and forced marriage survivor testimony, preserving our experiences and making them accessible to survivors, researchers, educators, advocates, and policymakers.

Through firsthand accounts, we expose the systems that enable abuse, challenge the silence, and strengthen efforts to protect children.

Find updates at www.tamaramc.com.

Welcome to the line. Sparkle on. Sparkle strong. 💖

~Tamara MC, Ph.D.

Satan, frustrated with his demons' inability to sow true chaos on Earth, sees in Dolores not just a source of entertainment but a potential weapon in his quest for greater evil. Can a woman whose life was marred by darkness truly become a harbinger of despair?

As Dolores navigates her new reality, she grapples with the weight of her past and the power her stories wield. "Damned: The Intimate Story Of A Girl" invites listeners on a chilling journey through the supernatural, blending horror and introspection in a way that raises questions about redemption, responsibility, and the human condition. With each tale, the stakes rise and the line between good and evil blurs, leaving you eager to discover what awaits Dolores in the heart of darkness. Will she embrace her fate or fight against the very forces that claim her? Tune in for a gripping exploration of morality and the supernatural that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

description:
Welcome to World of Payne, conservative commentary for Americans who are tired of being talked down to and want the news straight, with the history behind it.
I'm Tanner Payne. I'm a husband-to-be, a man of faith, a finance professional, and a small business owner from right here in Iowa. I spend my days working with real budgets, real balance sheets, and real people who feel every decision Washington makes. I started World of Payne because too much of what passes for news today is either noise, spin, or outrage built to keep you clicking. I wanted a show that slows down, looks at the facts, and asks the question that matters most: what does this mean for American families, American workers, and the country we're handing to the next generation?
World of Payne comes from a foundational fiscal conservative point of view, built on America First principles. That means a government that lives within its means, a strong economy that rewards work, secure borders, energy independence, a military that keeps us safe without wasting our money, and leaders who answer to the people who elected them. When taxpayer dollars are wasted, lost to fraud, or sent out in improper payments, we'll call it out by name, back it up with the numbers, and talk about real ways to fix it.
Every Tuesday, the World of Payne news episode breaks down six of the week's biggest stories, covering the economy, inflation, energy, national security, Congress, the courts, and the fight over how your money gets spent. The sixth story is always the biggest of the week, and we spend real time on it.
Every Thursday, the Building Blocks episode takes that big story and goes back in time. How has America handled this issue before? What decisions, laws, and turning points led us to where we are today? History doesn't repeat itself exactly, but it leaves us a roadmap, and understanding it is the best way to understand what comes next.
You won't hear shouting matches or recycled talking points here. You'll hear honest analysis, sourced facts, clear opinions labeled as opinions, and plain common sense from the heartland. Whether you agree with every word or not, you'll walk away understanding the issue better than when you started.
If you love this country and want to understand where it's headed, you're in the right place. Hit follow so you never miss a Tuesday or Thursday episode, share it with someone who needs to hear it, and join the conversation with us on X, Facebook, and Instagram.
This is World of Payne. Let's get to work.

Nicoleta Rotaru è una donna moldava di 37 anni, ha due figlie, un lavoro, molte amiche che le vogliono bene, una famiglia unita che ha lasciato nel suo Paese d’origine. Nella notte fra l’1 e il 2 agosto viene trovata senza vita nella casa in cui vive in provincia di Padova. 

In quella casa, oltre alle sue due bambine, vive ancora l’ex marito Erik Zorzi, da cui si era separata qualche mese prima e che rifiutava di lasciare l’abitazione.

I carabinieri, che dal 2021 Nicoleta erano stati a casa di Nicoleta 8 volte, archiviano la sua morte come un suicidio, ma le amiche e la famiglia non credono a questa versione dei fatti e chiedono verità e giustizia. Comincia così un’indagine che porterà alla scoperta di una serie di registrazioni fatte da Nicoleta, che per anni ha documentato la violenza subita. A incastrare l’ex marito sarà la registrazione dell’ultima notte.

title: Barefoot Conversations™
author: Andrea Davis
description:
Barefoot Conversations™ is a podcast with Andrea Davis built around real stories, real questions, and real conversations.
It is intentionally simple, raw, and organic. The goal is not a highly produced or perfectly scripted podcast. It is to create the feeling that Andrea and the listener are sitting together, having a conversation.

For Season One, Andrea begins with the place that started so much of this:
Already the One™: Welcome Home.
Each episode explores one section of the book. Andrea introduces the chapter, reads directly from her physical copy, and then puts the book down.

That is where the Barefoot Conversation begins.
Andrea has a few questions and thoughts to guide each episode, but the conversation that follows the reading is intentionally unscripted. It creates space for what Andrea hears differently now, what the chapter brings up for her today, and what questions it might bring up for the listener. Andrea wrote the book, but she is still living it. She is not here to provide all the answers.

Barefoot Conversations™ is about asking meaningful questions, making room to think about them, and allowing each person to discover what comes up in their own life.
The book provides the starting point.
Andrea's voice brings the words to life.
The conversation takes them beyond the page.


Me, you, a book, and some really good conversations.

🎙️ New episodes every Tuesday morning. Follow the podcast and come home to yourself—one conversation at a time.

In Piecing It Together, GP, broadcaster, BBC One Morning Live resident doctor and dad of two Dr Oscar Duke sets out to make sense of it all. Each episode starts with a puzzle, a real-life scenario playing out in homes and classrooms across the country. Oscar works through it with experts, educators and people with first-hand experience, asking the questions parents and teachers really want answered.

title: Stoically: Stoicism for Everyday Life
author: The Cynical Stoic
description:
Everything is going wrong, and the Stoics saw it coming. Two thousand years ago, Marcus Aurelius, Seneca and Epictetus worked out how to stay calm when life falls apart: traffic, bad bosses, bad news, and the fact that you will, eventually, die. Cheerful stuff.
 Stoically turns ancient Stoic philosophy into practical tools for everyday life. Each episode takes one idea, strips away the dusty textbook language, and shows you how to use it before your next bad day. You can't control what happens. You can control how you take it. And if that fails, at least you'll be dignified about it.
 No incense, no gurus, no pretending life isn't hard. Just old wisdom that still works. Press play, breathe, and remember: this too shall pass. So will you, but let's not rush it.

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz (Modern Fairy Tale)
author: L. Frank Baum
description:
When a tornado sweeps through Kansas, Dorothy finds herself in a vibrant land filled with talking animals and magical wonders. In L. Frank Baum's classic, *The Wonderful Wizard of Oz*, she embarks on a journey to meet the enigmatic Wizard, hoping to return home. Along the way, she befriends the Scarecrow, who yearns for a brain, the Tin Woodman, who longs for a heart, and the Cowardly Lion, desperate for courage. Each companion brings their own struggles and dreams, creating a rich tapestry of friendship and adventure.

As they travel the Yellow Brick Road, the group faces the fearsome Wicked Witch of the West, whose dark magic threatens to tear them apart. Will they overcome their inner demons and find the strength to confront their fears? This timeless tale explores themes of friendship, self-discovery, and the true meaning of home, engaging listeners of all ages.

Through enchanting storytelling and delightful characters, Baum invites you to experience the magic that has captivated hearts for over a century. With each chapter, listeners will uncover the wisdom that lies in believing in oneself and the power of companionship. Join Dorothy and her friends on this unforgettable adventure, and discover the lessons that await in the Land of Oz!

From seasons of struggle, doubt, and surrender to redemption, healing, and spiritual growth, we're talking about it ALL (without watering down the truth of God's Word).

title: Between Wounds & Wisdom Podcast
author: David Coombs
description: Between Wounds & Wisdom explores the space between hurt and healing, intention and impact, perception and reality, accountability and understanding. Through stories, research and conversations on psychology, neurodivergence, trauma, relationships, gender and restorative justice, we examine what we fail to see in ourselves and each other—what we can own, take responsibility for, learn from and change, and how compassion and understanding can bridge the divide between men and women and foster healing, connection, reconciliation and repair. Different minds. Different experiences. Shared humanity.

description: What if everything you’ve been told about building a personal brand is wrong? Hosted by Ashley Briana Eve, The Brand Heretic explores the intersection of branding psychology, human behaviour, reputation, perception and cultural influence. From brand archetypes and the psychology of emotional connection to public relations, pop culture, and the strategies behind the world’s most recognizable brands, this is a deeper look at why people connect with certain brands, what makes them memorable, and what ultimately makes them worth choosing.

The goal is to bridge science and clinical practice while highlighting meaningful advances in swallowing rehabilitation, instrumental assessment, and patient-centered care.

description:

Every week we examine how diet culture, body image issues and our own hectic lives get in the way of putting a dinner on the table that we can all feel good about. And we offer practical, road-tested tips to help you make peace with your own eating (or your kid's picky eating!) and find more joy in your family's food life. title: Built For Better
author: Adam Niffen
description:
Built For Better is a show about the spaces and systems that drive human performance, and the ones that hold us back.

I’m Adam Niffen. I’ve been studying this for over 15 years with one simple goal. Design spaces and systems that drive me to be a better performing human being. I’m an endurance athlete, a father, a husband and a family man. Most of all I’m a student of the mind, soul and spirit.

Three times a week we get into the science, the training, the faith and the structure behind high performance. We sit down with people working to be the highest performing humans they can be. And we take a hard look at the systems standing in the way, from food and healthcare to government, and what it takes to build new ones.

You’ll walk away with a deeper knowledge of self and a clearer picture of how to build a better human being.

title: No Flexibility Required
author: Bertena, Yoga Teacher
description: No Flexibility Required is the yoga podcast for beginners who think yoga is not for them. Hosted by Bertena of the Rose Temple Yoga School, this show offers gentle yoga guidance for people in larger bodies, people who have never taken a yoga class, and anyone who has ever felt too stiff, too old, or too out of place to begin.  Every episode meets you exactly where you are. You will find beginner friendly yoga explained in plain language, plus size yoga practices that honor the body you have today, chair yoga and gentle yoga options, and honest answers to the questions new students are afraid to ask.  New yoga teachers are welcome here too. Bertena shares what she has learned from years of teaching inclusive yoga for all bodies, so you can welcome every student who walks through your door with confidence.  You do not need to be flexible to start yoga. Flexibility is something yoga gives you, not something you need before you begin. Come as you are, and begin in the body you have.

title: WWII Unwound: The Research Files
author: Alan Best
description:
Show title: WWII Unwound: The Research Files

Show description:

The deep dive for people who want the whole story of World War II, not just the headlines.

WWII Unwound: The Research Files takes one subject at a time and goes all the way in. It covers the weapons and how they worked, the doctrine behind them, the numbers that matter, and the arguments historians still have. Each episode starts with a single research file, such as a battle, a machine, a campaign or a decision, and then follows the evidence.

Amanda asks the questions a curious listener would ask. Harry, our historian, answers with the detail military history enthusiasts want. Your host, Alan Best, is a U.S. Navy veteran, author and historian.

If you enjoy WWII Unwound and want more depth, this show is for you.

New episodes are on your favorite podcast app. Visit www.beststorypublishing.com or write to BestStoryPublishing@gmail.com.

A production of the Best Story Publishing Podcast Network.

author: Benjamin Ayres, Wes Brown and Paul Campbell
description:
Three friends. A few microphones. No particular agenda. Join Benjamin Ayres, Wes Brown and Paul Campbell for honest conversations, unexpected tangents and advice you probably shouldn’t take. From life on set to life at home, nothing is off the table—and nobody has all the answers.
Honest questions. Questionable advice.

title: Sun On Stone
author: Mike Kruk
description: Shedding light on the lives of the dead - ghost stories (personal experiences included), cemetery restoration, and history of the deceased.

title: Joseph: The Hidden King & Yahshua
author: Dr. Kananalli
description:
Joseph: The Hidden King & Yahshua — the untold story of Joseph of Nazareth: the hidden king, the man who raised Yahshua. Written and narrated by Dr. Kananalli. A new episode every Sunday.

title: FORGING THE FORGE | Mov'em Radio
author: KnyneThaGreat
description: Making every blade sharp! Before your music hits rotation, it first goes through THE FORGE. In this exclusive sit-down, Knynethagreat talks with artists about their journey, creative process, and the mindset behind the music. Hosted by Knynethagreat on Mov'em Radio — "You Send'em, We Mov'em."

title: On Trust With Beni
author: Beni Beeri Issembert
description:
On Trust With Beni — Conversations about trust in the age of AI.
What makes us trust something—or someone? I’m Beni Beeri Issembert. I build AI products, and I’m inviting people from technology, law, science and beyond to think this question through with me.
We’ll explore how trust is earned, what happens when it breaks, and what AI is changing about both.
Coming soon. Follow the show for the first conversations.

title: Repeat or Delete With Sarie Taylor And Special Guests
author: Sarie
description: Trained psychotherapist and celebrity coach Sarie Taylor sits down with famous faces you'll recognise for honest, warm and often funny conversations about stress, anxiety and overthinking. Together they work out which thoughts are worth keeping on repeat and which are ready to be deleted.

title: Make Love Make Sense
author: Allie Cruse
description: I'm Allie Cruse, and alongside my husband Josh, we're exploring the hard-to-have conversations about love, sex, dating, and relationships that don't make it into health class or dinner table discussions. After years of navigating relationships away from God and eventually finding our way back to Him and His law, we have a lot of different perspectives on love, intimacy, and commitment. Through honest conversations, guests, and personal stories, we’re exploring the topics that deserve a LOT more attention!

title: Welcome to Wroxham
author: Future Radio
description:
Welcome to Wroxham is the podcast that takes you right into the heart of Wroxham FC.
From their vantage point in the Crows Nest at Trafford Park, commentators Nigel Westall and Tom Lorenzo keep a close eye on everything happening on and off the pitch. They report on the matches, share their observations and reactions, and speak to the staff, players and supporters to capture the stories, personalities and atmosphere that make Wroxham FC such a special club.

title: Almost Awake
author: Avery Jordan
description: Almost Awake is a podcast for people who think a lot and occasionally spiral about society, but in a fun way. This show explores culture, unspoken rules, and the weird systems we all live inside of. Expect thoughtful takes, personal stories, humor, and moments of “wait… why do we do this?” This isn’t about having life figured out, it’s about being curious, questioning the default, and choosing awareness over autopilot.

title: The Year-End Reset
author: Baradello Publishing
description: Welcome to "The Year-End Reset," an exhaustive 5-part masterclass series dedicated to the psychology of life transitions, emotional closure, and intentional planning. Across five heavily expanded episodes, we examine how to conduct a compassionate annual audit, let go of past regrets and unfinished projects, extract vital wisdom from failures, design three core pillars for the upcoming year, and establish powerful rituals of passage between December and January.

title: No Crying In Tech
author: No Crying In Tech
description:
Most tech news explains what happened. No Crying in Tech is a weekly tech podcast for women that explains what it actually means for you and what to do about it. Each week, we break down the biggest stories in AI, Silicon Valley, digital privacy, B2B and consumer tech through the lens mainstream coverage skips i.e the real impact on women's money, safety, health, and careers. 
Every episode ends with practical takeaways like settings to change, scams to spot, and smart moves to make right now so you own the tech, not the other way around. New episodes weekly. Follow now.

title: Massively Insightful
author: Selin Kurnaz
description: Massively Insightful is a podcast hosted by Selin Kurnaz, Co-Founder and CEO of Massive Bio, an AI-driven precision oncology company connecting cancer patients to clinical trials across 17+ countries. Each episode brings together leading voices in oncology, healthcare innovation, and health technology to explore how artificial intelligence is transforming cancer care. From clinical trial access to precision medicine and digital health, we go deep on the ideas and breakthroughs shaping the future of oncology.

title: Jets Media
author: Roundtable Sports
description: This channel will be covering all of the latest news on the New York Jets. I will be uploading weekly videos of all Jets related content. LETS GO JETS #TakeFlight
